caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a dark brown or black face and hands, featuring painted facial features such as wide eyes, arched eyebrows, a small nose, and prominent red lips. The doll has wavy, dark-colored hair styled away from the face. It is dressed in a long, light blue dress with subtle vertical stripes or patterns and a high collar. The dress has long sleeves with cuffs and a fitted waist, with the skirt flaring out and ending at the doll’s feet, partially covering black shoes. The background is plain and unadorned, and there is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Bertha Semple." The overall composition is centered, with the doll occupying most of the vertical space.
title: Negro Woman Doll
